A pro forma still in draft, or finalised without ever being submitted, is not returned to the client. A contractor reading its own pro formas sees every status. The same rule decides what the invoice, charge and attachment endpoints return.

SurfaceDrillAndBlastGroundCondition.description: One ground condition recorded against a depth range inside a surface drilling interval. Accounts that do not use ground conditions never record any, so this list is empty for them. `ground_condition_id` names the catalogue entry the driller picked. Resolve that id with `GET /ground-conditions/`.
